nodes.name: tool-launcher.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the core AI-tool launch and hook-command infrastructure for the AI-OS arc, exporting `launchTool` to spawn external tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) detached from the sidecar process and `runHookCommand` to install, uninstall, and verify per-tool hive-mind hooks via their npm package CLIs.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses dependency injection (SpawnDetachedFn/ExecCaptureFn) with real defaults and mock overrides for testing; HOOKS_COHORT and LAUNCH_COHORT are exported const arrays acting as capability registries.

nodes.name: defaultSpawnDetached
nodes.summary: Default implementation that spawns an external binary fully detached from the Node.js process (stdio ignored, child unreffed) and returns the process ID or an error string.

nodes.name: defaultExecCapture
nodes.summary: Default implementation that runs a binary with execFile, captures stdout/stderr, and returns a structured result with exit code, stdout, and stderr strings.

nodes.name: launchTool
nodes.summary: Exported entry point that validates a tool ID against the LAUNCH_COHORT allowlist, resolves injected or default spawn/exec dependencies, and spawns the requested AI tool detached with an optional workspace context argument.

nodes.name: hookPackageFor
nodes.summary: Exported helper that maps a tool ID to its corresponding hive-mind hook npm package name (e.g. 'claude-code' → '@waggle/hive-mind-hooks-claude-code').

nodes.name: runHookCommand
nodes.summary: Exported function that runs install, uninstall, or verify hook commands by resolving the correct hive-mind-hooks package binary via npx and executing it with the appropriate flags and workspace directory.

nodes.name: phase4-hooks-cohort.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest test suite that validates the Phase 4 AI-OS hooks cohort — verifying that HOOKS_COHORT entries are recognized, that each cohort tool has a corresponding hive-mind-hooks npm package with a declared binary, and that `runHookCommand` executes install/uninstall/verify commands correctly against mocked exec capture.

nodes.name: tool-launcher.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Vitest test suite for `launchTool` and `runHookCommand` covering cohort validation, spawn argument construction, workspace injection, detached-mode verification, hook command routing, and error paths for unsupported tools.

nodes.name: captureSpawn
nodes.summary: Test helper factory that returns a spy-capable spawnDetached stub recording all invocation calls for assertion.

nodes.name: captureExec
nodes.summary: Test helper factory that returns a spy-capable execCapture stub with a configurable result payload, recording all invocation calls for assertion.
